name: Milos Kerkez

career_stints.note: 2022/23 season totals (all competitions) -- his one full breakout season before the Bournemouth move; AZ finished 4th and reached the Europa Conference League semi-final. A separately reported partial-season split (22 games/3 goals/6 assists at age 18) reflects an earlier, different sub-period and was not used to avoid double counting.

Premier League only. Featured in all 38 PL fixtures under Iraola -- his final and most Iraola-relevant Bournemouth season, directly overlapping with the manager prior used elsewhere in this project. A separately reported 'career total before Liverpool' figure (100 apps/4 goals/7 assists, combining AZ + Bournemouth) is inconsistent with this season alone plus the AZ figure above and was not used -- flagged in notes rather than reconciled by guesswork.

Debut Liverpool season, reuniting with Iraola from Bournemouth. 8 shots, 2 on target reported for the season, but total minutes were not verifiable from an accessible source, so per-90 figures were not derived from this.

notes: £40m transfer from Bournemouth to Liverpool confirmed June 2025 (Sky Sports, liverpoolfc.com) -- his Bournemouth spell under Iraola is the direct individual/manager overlap case for this project's Bayesian prior.

A 'career total before Liverpool' figure of 100 apps/4 goals/7 assists (combining AZ + Bournemouth) appeared in one source but is arithmetically inconsistent with the season-level AZ (52/5/7) and Bournemouth 2024/25 (38/2/6) figures used here -- not used, flagged as a disagreement rather than picked or averaged.
